params.name: filter
params.description: Value must be of the format `filter={FILTER KEY} gte YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ lte YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. A `{FILTER KEY}` must be specified, and currently the keys that are supported for `/threats` are `receivedTime` and `latestTimeRemediated`. At least 1 of `gte`/`lte` must be specified, with a datetime string following the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ format`.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of threats on each page. Each page of data will have at most pageSize threats. Has no effect if filter is not specified.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: 1-indexed page number to get a particular page of threats. Has no effect if filter is not specified.

params.name: source
params.description: Filters threats based on the source of detection. 'all' returns threats from all sources, 'spam' returns only spam threats, 'attacks' returns only attack threats, and 'borderline' returns only borderline threats.

params.name: sender
params.description: Filters threats based on the name or email address of the sender

params.name: recipient
params.description: Filters threats based on the name or email address of the recipient

params.name: subject
params.description: Filters threats based on the email subject

params.name: topic
params.description: Filters threats based on the topic of email contents

params.name: attackType
params.description: Filters threats based on the type of attack

params.name: attackVector
params.description: Filters threats based on the attack vector

params.name: attackStrategy
params.description: Filters threats based on the attack strategy

params.name: impersonatedParty
params.description: Filters threats based on the impersonated party

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of messages corresponding to threat in each page. Each page of data will have at most pageSize message. Total results returned cannot exceed 2000 due to database limitations

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: 1-indexed page number to get a particular page of threat messages. Currently ignored, only 10 results for `messages` will show. Supported will be added in a future version. Total results returned cannot exceed 2000 due to database limitations
